title: ⭐ Unit Check: Linear Equations & Word Problems

steps.prompt: Before the check: which kind of word problem do you set up fastest now, and which one still makes you stop and think?

cards.title: Equations and systems: quick review
cards.body: Name the unknown, write what the words say, clear fractions by multiplying both sides. Consecutive numbers: $n$, $n + 1$, $n + 2$ (odd or even: $n$, $n + 2$, $n + 4$). For two unknowns, add or subtract the equations to cancel a letter, and look for a shortcut to what is asked, like $x + y$.

cards.title: Word problems: quick review
cards.body: $d = rt$: towards each other, speeds add; chasing, they subtract. Work: rates ($\frac{1}{\text{time}}$) add, and a drain subtracts. Mixtures: follow the pure part. Ages: make a table; age differences never change. Coins: one equation for how many, one for how much.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which set-up habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
